about: Record a UAE national's farm in the ministry system to use its farmer services.
note: Requirements read from the official MOCCAE service page on the checked date. MOCCAE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Register an agricultural holding. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Holder must be a UAE national, and a lessee must also be a UAE national
The farm must be fenced and have an irrigation water source
documents: Lessee: lease contract from the owner
Heirs: court inheritance document and power of attorney from all heirs
timing: 2 working days, after an inspection visit
